title: Can Your Buyer Actually Insure Your Home? Southwest Florida 2026
excerpt: Florida law limits when a carrier can refuse a policy over roof age, and Citizens has hard eligibility walls at a $700,000 dwelling replacement cost and at $750,000 in the wind-borne debris region. The buyer's insurance quote lands in the 34 days between contract and closing, the one stretch of the timeline a seller cannot shorten by pricing better.
